name: EU AI Act — High-Risk System Requirements
description: Chapter III obligations for high-risk AI systems (Articles 9-15) plus provider and deployer duties. Informational, not legal advice.

rules.title: Risk-management system
rules.description: A continuous, iterative risk-management system is established and maintained across the AI lifecycle.

check.question: Is there a continuous, iterative risk-management system across the AI lifecycle?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 9 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Data & data governance
rules.description: Training, validation, and testing datasets are relevant, representative, and examined for bias.

check.question: Are training/validation/testing datasets relevant, representative, and examined for bias?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 10 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Technical documentation
rules.description: Annex IV technical documentation is drawn up and kept up to date.

check.question: Is Annex IV technical documentation drawn up and kept up to date?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 11 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Record-keeping / logging
rules.description: The system automatically records events (logs) over its lifetime to ensure traceability.

check.question: Does the system automatically record events (logs) over its lifetime for traceability?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 12 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Transparency to deployers
rules.description: Clear instructions for use are provided so deployers can interpret and use output correctly.

check.question: Are clear instructions for use provided so deployers can interpret and use output correctly?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 13 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Human oversight
rules.description: The system is designed for effective human oversight, including the ability to stop or override it.

check.question: Is the system designed for effective human oversight (including stop/override)?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 14 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Accuracy, robustness & cybersecurity
rules.description: The system achieves appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity.

check.question: Does the system meet appropriate accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity levels?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 15 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Quality management system
rules.description: A documented quality-management system is in place.

check.question: Is a documented quality-management system in place?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 17 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Documentation retention
rules.description: Documentation is retained for 10 years after the system is placed on the market.

check.question: Is documentation retained for 10 years after the system is placed on the market?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 18 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Conformity assessment
rules.description: The system has undergone the required conformity-assessment procedure.

check.question: Has the system undergone the required conformity-assessment procedure?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 43 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: EU declaration of conformity
rules.description: An EU declaration of conformity has been drawn up.

check.question: Has an EU declaration of conformity been drawn up?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 47 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: CE marking
rules.description: The CE marking is affixed where applicable.

check.question: Is the CE marking affixed (where applicable)?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 48 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: EU-database registration
rules.description: The high-risk system is registered in the EU database before being placed on the market.

check.question: Is the high-risk system registered in the EU database before being placed on the market?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 49 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Deployer obligations
rules.description: The deployer uses the system per instructions, ensures human oversight, and monitors operation.

check.question: Does the deployer use the system per instructions, ensure human oversight, and monitor operation?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the deployer obligations under Article 26 before putting the high-risk system into use.

rules.title: Post-market monitoring
rules.description: A post-market monitoring system collects and reviews performance data.

check.question: Is there a post-market monitoring system collecting and reviewing performance data?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 72 before placing the high-risk system on the market.

rules.title: Serious-incident reporting
rules.description: Serious incidents are reported to the relevant market-surveillance authority within the required timeframe.

check.question: Are serious incidents reported to the relevant market-surveillance authority within the required timeframe?

rules.remediation: Implement and document the obligation under Article 73 before placing the high-risk system on the market.
